verification: 68 normal and 68 optimized tests passed; all four analytical outputs byte-identical; warning-free three-pass PDF rebuild; 32-page contact-sheet and full-size bibliography review.
change_scope: Author-approved removal of private input filenames; scientific substance and analytical code/results unchanged.

source_verification.scope: Research publication and supplied models only

clean_extracted_source_verification.scope: Research publication and supplied models only

publication_byte_check.scope: Publication delivery only; no GENESIS runtime test.

static_delivery.scope: Nested-path localhost HTTP delivery of the actual website ZIP. Not browser navigation or a live public-host test.

browser_validation.method: Offline document injection with exact CSS/JS bytes and hash-permitted CSP. No hosted or file navigation qualification.
browser_validation.limitation: Managed Chromium blocked direct HTTP loopback and file navigation (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR). Release source and URL links are checked separately.

original_supplied_release_validation.substantive_correction: The conventional replay control is computed with a separate implementation, rather than copied from the candidate result. The original numeric tie is preserved.
not_established: Actual customer demand or collected revenue
External peer review or independent production-security audit
original_supplied_release_validation.distribution_boundary: Use WEBSITE.zip for static publication and SOURCE.zip for executable research. Neither deploys the proposed autonomous foundry.

history_boundary: Earlier Git history is not claimed to be erased.
